answer: Let trust flow from a few verified seed accounts through endorsement links, each link carrying only a small capped amount. A newcomer's weight is the total flow reaching it, so a sybil farm's thousand puppets share one thin inflow: their internal links merely recirculate it, like a marble rolling in a closed bowl. To gain weight, an attacker must earn links from trusted outsiders, costing time and useful work. An honest willow grows from a single anchor root; fake roots receive almost nothing. Limits: seed sets can be biased or captured, and isolated honest newcomers gain trust slowly.
